title: Director of Business Development - Wholesale Banking

Identify and evaluate new business opportunities by analyzing market trends and client needs, ensuring that strategic initiatives are data-driven and focused on maximizing revenue. Lead and mentor a team of business development professionals, providing guidance and support to ensure they achieve their individual and collective targets while promoting a culture of excellence. Collaborate with marketing and product development teams to create innovative solutions that meet client demands and differentiate our services from competitors. Monitor and report on industry trends, competitor activities, and client feedback to inform strategic decision-making and adapt business development efforts accordingly. Prepare and present compelling proposals and presentations to prospective clients, showcasing our agency's capabilities and the value we bring to the wholesale banking sector. Manage the business development budget effectively, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently to maximize return on investment and achieve financial objectives. Continuously assess and refine business development processes and practices to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and overall performance across the organization. Skills Proven experience in business development within the banking or financial services sector, with a strong understanding of wholesale banking operations. Exceptional strategic planning and analytical skills to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans. Strong leadership abilities to inspire and motivate a diverse team towards achieving common goals. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and stakeholders at all levels. Proficiency in market research and competitive analysis tools to inform decision-making and strategy development. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of attention to detail and quality. Demonstrated financial acumen to effectively manage budgets and assess business performance metrics.
